name: account-fit-check
title: Account fit check
short: Check a list of company domains against the user's must-have criteria ("do they sell to enterprises?", "do they offer an API?", "do they book appointments in their product?") by reading each company's own website, and hand back yes with the quoted passage and page link, not_found or unclear for every company, keeping only the fits before anyone pays for people or emails.

name: call-brief
title: Call brief
short: Before a sales call, build a one-page brief on the company and the person the user is meeting: what the company does and how it is doing, its recent moves with dated sources, who the user is likely meeting and what they have posted lately, and three sharp questions that only make sense after reading it.

name: champion-tracker
title: Champion tracker
short: Check a list of past champions, happy users or former customers for anyone who has moved to a new company, confirm the new company is a fit, and hand back each mover with their new work email (checked) and a short "congrats on the new role" opener, plus who took over at their old company.

name: hiring-manager-finder
title: Hiring manager finder
short: Find the person who owns a specific open role.

name: inbound-triage
title: Inbound triage
short: Sort new sign-ups and demo requests that arrive from a form with a name, a company and an email address.

name: list-cleanup
title: List cleanup
short: Clean an existing contact list the user already has, before it gets emailed.

name: lookalike-accounts
title: Lookalike accounts
short: Start from one to three customer domains the user names and find companies similar to them, saying on what basis each one matches and how closely, dropping poor fits, and optionally confirming the trait that made those customers buy on each company's own website, then hand back a ranked account list ready for finding contacts.

name: my-post-engagers
title: My post engagers
short: Turn the people who engaged with the user's own recent LinkedIn posts, or their own company page's posts, into a warm list.

name: warm-leads-from-post
title: Warm leads from someone else's post
short: Turn the audience of someone else the user's buyers follow into warm leads.

name: who-to-contact-first
title: Who to contact first
short: Rank a list of people the user already has (name, company, LinkedIn URL) by who to contact this week, using each person's recent public LinkedIn activity (their own posts, comments, reactions, or posts they were named in), each with the signal, its date, the link and a first line that refers to it naturally.
